app.name: TikTok
app.description: A short-form video platform for creating, sharing, and discovering content, with live streaming, shopping features, and personalized recommendations.

verdict.one_liner: Extensive data collection including keystroke patterns and face analysis, with broad sharing across advertising networks.
verdict.summary: TikTok collects extensive data including account details, content, messages, clipboard, contacts, and identity documents. It tracks usage behavior, infers sensitive attributes (interests, gender, age), and collects keystroke patterns, device identifiers, and location. Face and body features are analyzed in uploaded videos. Data is shared with advertisers, business partners, corporate affiliates, and law enforcement. Users have data rights and can delete accounts, but retention is broad.
verdict.recommendation_reason: TikTok's data collection is exceptionally broad, including keystroke patterns, face/body analysis, and cross-device tracking. Combined with extensive sharing with advertisers and corporate partners, this poses significant privacy risks.

red.title: Collects keystroke patterns and rhythms
red.plain_english: TikTok states it collects 'keystroke patterns or rhythms' as part of technical information about your device.

red.title: Analyzes face and body features in your videos
red.plain_english: TikTok collects information about videos and images, including 'the existence and location within an image of face and body features and attributes' for effects, moderation, demographic classification, and ad recommendations.

red.title: Infers your interests, gender, and age range
red.plain_english: TikTok explicitly states it infers your attributes, including interests, gender, and age range, for personalizing content.

red.title: Tracks activity across multiple devices
red.plain_english: TikTok uses device IDs and user ID to identify activity across devices, and may associate you with information from devices other than those you use to log in.

red.title: Shares data with advertisers and partners
red.plain_english: TikTok shares information with advertisers, advertising partners, publishers, third-party measurement companies, business partners, service providers, and corporate affiliates.

red.title: Keeps data indefinitely for broad purposes
red.plain_english: TikTok retains information as long as necessary to provide the Platform, plus for legal obligations, legitimate business interests, and defense of legal claims.

green.title: You can delete your account
green.plain_english: TikTok allows you to delete your entire account in Settings.

green.title: Data rights request portal available
green.plain_english: TikTok provides a privacy portal to submit requests for access, deletion, update, or rectification of your data.

green.title: Privacy controls for content visibility
green.plain_english: TikTok provides Settings tools to control who can view videos, send messages, or post comments.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera and microphone are used for creating content. TikTok analyzes objects, scenery, face/body features, and spoken words in uploaded videos.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone access is required for creating and uploading videos and livestreams. TikTok collects User Content through pre-loading at creation time. The platform analyzes video content including objects, scenery, face and body features/attributes, and text of spoken words for effects, moderation, demographic classification, and recommendations.
categories.policy_excerpt: We process the content you generate on the Platform... We may collect information about the videos, images and audio that are a part of your User Content, such as identifying the objects and scenery that appear, the existence and location within an image of face and body features and attributes
concerns: Audio content analyzed for spoken words

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Approximate location collected automatically via SIM card and IP address. Precise GPS collected with permission.
categories.detail: Approximate location is inferred automatically from SIM card and IP address without requiring explicit permission. Precise GPS location is collected only with explicit permission. Location information from User Content is also collected if you choose to add it.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about your approximate location, including location information based on your SIM card and/or IP address. With your permission, we may also collect precise location data (such as GPS).
concerns: Approximate location collected automatically without permission
IP address used for location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you sync phone contacts, TikTok accesses names, phone numbers, and email addresses to match against existing users.
categories.detail: Contact sync is optional. If enabled, TikTok accesses and collects names, phone numbers, and email addresses from phone and social network contacts. This is matched against existing users for friend suggestions. Social network public profile information is also collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to sync your phone contacts, we will access and collect information such as names, phone numbers, and email addresses, and match that information against existing users of the Platform.
concerns: Social network contacts also collected if shared

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: User Content is pre-loaded at creation time regardless of whether you save or upload. Clipboard accessed with permission.
categories.detail: User Content (photos, videos, audio) is collected through pre-loading at the time of creation, import, or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or upload. Clipboard content is accessed with permission for sharing or pasting content.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect User Content through pre-loading at the time of creation, import, or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or upload that User Content
concerns: Content pre-loaded before explicit save decision

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Extensive sharing with advertisers, business partners, service providers, corporate affiliates, researchers, sellers, and law enforcement. Data may transfer in M&A.
categories.detail: Data is shared with business partners, service providers (cloud, moderation, marketing), payment processors, advertisers and ad networks, independent researchers, corporate group affiliates, and law enforcement when required. Data may be disclosed in sale, merger, or business transactions. Aggregated statistics shared with analytics users.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share your information with the following parties: Business Partners... Service Providers... Advertisers, Advertising Networks, Publishers, and Measurement Partners... Our Corporate Group... in the event that we sell or buy any business or assets
concerns: Shared with law enforcement when required

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Collects username, password, DOB, email/phone, profile photo/video. May require proof of identity/age for certain features.
categories.detail: Registration requires username, password, date of birth (where applicable), email address and/or telephone number, profile information, and photograph or profile video. Proof of identity or age may be requested for livestream, verified accounts, business accounts, or age verification purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: You give us information when you register on the Platform, including your username, password, date of birth (where applicable), email address and/or telephone number... We sometimes ask you to provide proof of identity or age in order to use certain features

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Heavy tracking of usage behavior. Infers interests, gender, age. Uses cookies and web beacons for on and off-platform tracking.
categories.detail: Usage information collected includes how you engage with content, ads viewed, videos watched, browsing and search history, liked content, saved favorites, followed users. Cookies and web beacons used to track on and off Platform. Infers attributes including interests, gender, and age range for personalization. Third-party data from advertisers and partners used to match outside activities with TikTok account.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information regarding your use of the Platform, e.g., how you engage with the Platform, including how you interact with content we show to you, the advertisements you view... We also infer your attributes, including your interests, gender and age range for the purpose of personalising content.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Platform not directed at children under 13 (16 in some regions like Australia, 18 in others). Age verification may include ID submission.
categories.detail: TikTok states it is not directed at children under 13. Higher minimum ages apply in certain regions (16 in Australia, 18 in Egypt, Israel, Kenya, Nigeria, etc.). Age verification may require proof of identity. Guardian's Guide available for parents.
categories.policy_excerpt: TikTok is not directed at children under the age of 13. In certain cases this age may be higher due to local regulatory requirements
concerns: Higher age requirements in some jurisdictions
ID may be required for age verification

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Collects IP address, user agent, mobile carrier, time zone, and network type automatically.
categories.detail: IP address, user agent, mobile carrier, time zone settings, and network type are collected automatically. IP address and SIM card information used to determine approximate location.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect certain information about the device you use to access the Platform, such as your IP address, user agent, mobile carrier, time zone settings... We collect information about your approximate location, including location information based on your SIM card and/or IP address.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Extensive device collection including keystroke patterns, advertising IDs, device IDs, with cross-device tracking.
categories.detail: Collects advertising identifiers, device IDs, user IDs (automatically assigned), device model, device system, network type, screen resolution, operating system, app and file names/types, keystroke patterns or rhythms, battery state, audio settings, connected audio devices. Cross-device tracking explicitly implemented - may associate you with devices you don't use to log in.
categories.policy_excerpt: identifiers for advertising purposes, model of your device, the device system, network type, your screen resolution and operating system, app and file names and types, keystroke patterns or rhythms, battery state... Where you log-in from multiple devices, we use your information such as your device IDs and user ID to identify your activity across devices.
concerns: Association with devices you don't log in from

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Analyzes face and body features/attributes in videos for effects, moderation, demographic classification, and recommendations.
categories.detail: TikTok collects information about videos and images including existence and location of face and body features and attributes. This is used to enable special video effects, content moderation, demographic classification, content and ad recommendations. Also analyzes nature of audio.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect information about the videos, images and audio that are a part of your User Content, such as identifying the objects and scenery that appear, the existence and location within an image of face and body features and attributes
concerns: Face feature analysis in uploaded content

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment card info, billing, delivery, and contact information collected for purchases.
categories.detail: Payment card information, billing, delivery, and contact information collected when purchasing TikTok Coins or goods through shopping features. Transaction details and items purchased also collected. Shared with sellers, payment providers, and fulfillment providers.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you make a purchase or payment on or through the Platform, including when you buy TikTok Coins or purchase goods through our shopping features, we collect information about the purchase or payment transaction, such as payment card information, billing, delivery, and contact information
concerns: Email may be shared with sellers for marketing

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Account and User Content can be deleted. Data rights portal available. Broad retention for legal, safety, and business purposes.
categories.detail: Users can delete account and User Content in Settings. Privacy portal available for exercising data rights (access, deletion, update, rectification). However, retention is broad: kept as long as necessary to provide Platform, plus for contractual/legal obligations, legitimate business interests, and defense of legal claims. Some data may be kept after account deletion for violations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Should you choose to do so, you may delete your entire account in Settings. We retain information for as long as necessary to provide the Platform and for the other purposes set out in this Privacy Policy.
concerns: Data kept for legal and business purposes
Violation data retained even after account removal

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Continued use after policy update constitutes acceptance. Changes notified by updating 'Last Updated' date.
categories.detail: Policy updates notified by updating the 'Last Updated' date and posting the new policy. Continued access or use after the updated date constitutes acceptance. If you don't agree, you must stop using the Platform.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your continued access to or use of the Platform after the date of the updated policy constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy. If you do not agree to the updated policy, you must stop accessing or using the Platform.
